subject: Mutual action plan kickoff — technical rallypoint & MAP draft
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lina Zhao <lina.zhao@unitell.ai>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@unitell.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan kickoff — technical rallypoint & MAP draft

Hi Lina / Marco,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — excited about the potential for Unitell to move inference workloads onto Redwood. Per our mutual timeline we want to kick off a short MAP to validate latency, cost, and privacy requirements and get to a purchase decision by the end of September.

Quick introductions:
- Ben Carter (me) — your Redwood AE, will own the commercial timeline and coordinate stakeholders.
- Aditya Rao — Solutions Engineer focused on architecture and the evaluation plan (cc'd).
- Marissa Cole — Customer Success partner to ensure ramp and onboarding.

What we propose (attached draft MAP + checklist):
1) Week 1 (this week): technical discovery & infra alignment — identify test dataset, infra access, and security checkpoints.
2) Week 2–3: run eval (performance and cost) on representative traffic pattern.
3) Week 4: review results and finalize SOW/commit.

Can you confirm: who will be the day-to-day engineering contact at Unitell (for remote access, test dataset, and perf criteria)? Also please confirm any compliance gating (SOC2/ITAR/etc.) we should be aware of for the evaluation environment.

Attachments: RDW_MAP_Draft_v0.1.pdf, evaluation_checklist.xlsx

Next steps: if Lina/Marco ok, Aditya will send a short tech plan and a proposed test harness. If you prefer a quick kickoff call, we have availability tomorrow 11:00–12:00 PDT or Thursday 15:00–16:00 PDT.

Thanks,
— Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0137

From: Lina Zhao <lina.zhao@unitell.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@unitell.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com>, procurement@unitell.ai
Date: 2026-08-25T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan kickoff — technical rallypoint & MAP draft

Ben — thanks, this looks good. Quick answers up front:
- Day-to-day eng contact: me (Lina Zhao), engineering lead for Model Infra. I'll loop in our infra owner Marco for access work.
- Compliance: Unitell is SOC2 in progress; we need to validate data handling and can share the standard questionnaire. No ITAR.

We like the timeline but need to confirm our internal approvals. Proposed kickoff call: Thu 15:00 PDT works for me.

A couple of asks for the tech plan so we can prep:
- A short list of the evaluation VM/container images and the minimal network ports we must open.
- Expected dataset size and whether synthetic data is acceptable for the first pass.

Marco (cc) — are you able to provide a service account or a jump host for the eval?

Thanks,
Lina
Lina Zhao
Engineering Lead, Model Infrastructure
Lina.Zhao@unitell.ai | +1 212-555-4466

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan kickoff — technical rallypoint & MAP draft

Thanks Lina — happy to lead the technical side. Short tech plan / checklist to prep your infra before the kickoff call:

1) Access & infra
- We prefer a short-lived service account + SSH jump host, or a pre-provisioned test cluster in your GCP/AWS account.
- Minimal ports: 22 (ssh), 443 (control plane), 8079 (inference grpc/http endpoint for tests) — we can provide a CIDR whitelist.

2) Test dataset & size
- For initial latency/cost profiling a 10k-row synthetic payload reflecting your average prompt length is fine. If you want full QA we can run on a 100k sample in Week 2.

3) Baseline tests (what we'll run)
- Cold start latency (p95), steady-state throughput at target concurrency, token-level cost delta with/without KV cache and batching.
- Memory and GC traces — we may ask for a short perf-agent deployment to capture OS-level metrics.

4) Deliverables & checkpoints
- Day 3: smoke report + any infra blockers.
- End of Week 2: performance report, cost model, and recommended prod config.

Attachment: infra-specs.md (short checklist and sample commands). Shared drive link with a test harness repo: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP

If Thu 15:00 PDT is our kickoff I will drop a Zoom + agenda (30 min) focused on access, sample payload, and success criteria.

Quick note to Marissa: we should align on acceptance criteria that will be handed to the procurement team for SOW sign-off.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0199

Perfect — thanks everyone.

Confirming next steps and owners (MAP snapshot below):
- Owner: Ben Carter (commercial) — track approvals, procurement, and schedule decision meeting. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/54721
- Tech lead: Aditya Rao — run eval and produce perf/cost report.
- Day-to-day contact: Lina Zhao (Unitell) — infra access and dataset lead.
- CS: Marissa Cole — onboarding and enablement.

Immediate asks for Unitell before Thu 15:00 PDT kickoff:
1) Provide a jump host/service account OR a short-lived pre-provisioned test cluster.
2) Share the small sample (10k rows) or confirm we can use synthetic first pass.
3) Procurement: if you can share any non-negotiable contract terms we should be aware of, cc procurement@unitell.ai.

I've uploaded an editable MAP snapshot and the evaluation checklist to the shared Drive. Attaching the latest MAP PDF as well (RDW_MAP_Draft_v0.1.pdf).

If Thu 15:00 works we'll send a calendar invite with a 30-minute agenda. Looking forward to it.

— Ben
